messages.text: Wrong product.  I ordered a Hammer Miner BC04 (6TH/s) but instead, I received what looks like Wingbits WB200 (HYFIX spatial intelligence).  Please advise.
Used the customer-care skill
Used the store-orders skill

Sorry about that, getting the wrong unit is frustrating. I'll sort it out.

Can you send me your order number and one detail from the order, like the name it ships to or the postcode? Once I've found it, I'll check what's on the order and get the BC04 moving.

Until then, please keep the WB200 boxed and don't set it up.
Shop····,  Frederick L., (address hidden), Fairfield CA (postal code ····)
Ran order_status.py (store-orders skill)
Used the store-orders skill

Thanks, Frederick. My order lookup can only match on the email address the order was placed with, so the name and address you sent aren't enough for me to pull it up.

What email did you check out with? If there's no email on this order, just tell me and I'll pass your order number and details to the team so they can sort out the wrong unit.
(email hidden)
Ran order_status.py (store-orders skill)
Handed to the team · Packing error on a delivered order. Needs a replacement shipment and a return la

I found it, Frederick. Your order Shop···· is for one Hammer Miner BC04, and it shows delivered on September 24, so a WB200 in the box means it was packed wrong on our side. Sorry about that.

I've sent your order to the team so they can ship the BC04 and send you a return label for the WB200. Keep the WB200 boxed until then.

Please stay in this chat, someone from the team will reply here. If you step away, the answer will come to your email.
It's in the original product box.  I will have to find a new shipping box.  The original shipping box is a little beat up but the unit and the box is in excellent condition.

That helps, thanks. The W.200 is still in its original product box and in excellent condition, so it's ready to go back.

Hang on to the beat-up shipping box for now. The team will send the return label and tell you how they want it packed, so you may not need a new box. Please stay here, someone will reply in this chat or by email.

You're all set on my end, Frederick. Your order and the details on the WB200's condition are with the team.

Nobody has replied yet. When they do, it'll be here in the chat or by email, usually within one business day. They'll send the return label, tell you how to pack the WB200 and ship your BC04.

Can I help with anything else while you wait?
Sorry I cant stay here much longer.  Please have your team email me with the instruction.  Actually, can you tell me when the Magic Miner (40T) may ship?  First Wave.
Searched the catalog · Magic Miner 40T

No problem, Frederick. The team will email the return instructions to (email hidden), so you can close this chat.

First-wave (Batch 1) Magic Miner 40Ts ship October 31. The only batch still on sale is Batch 5, at $799, and it ships November 14.

If you already have a first-wave order, send me the order number and I'll check it.
I do have a first wave order.  Shop····
Ran order_status.py (store-orders skill)

Found it. Order Shop···· is paid and hasn't shipped yet. Your first-wave Magic (address hidden), Miner Duster and Power Kit ship October 31.

Your first-wave order came with the lower price and the included accessories.

The team will email you about the WB200 return and your BC04. Thanks for your patience today, Frederick.
Thanks and have a nice day
You're welcome, Frederick. You have a good one too.
